notes: Chunk 60: 25 candidates; 8 program-list, 1 single-record, 16 not-a-list. The six UBC Sauder per-cohort alumni pages (1986, 1989, 1999, 2001, 2003, 2014) are one series: the /Alumni/2014 page is the landing page linking cohort pages for every year 1972-2013, so the remaining cohort years are worth capturing. They give the current affiliation as of the 9/20/2017 update and a division code (SC = operations/logistics, TRANS = transportation, POL = policy, MIS, FIN, ACC, MKT, OB), not first jobs or graduation months; only alumni who gave permission have affiliation shown. The UCI Merage dissertations page has no years or placements but names six ODT graduates. The UCLA Anderson 2017-18 job-market page names candidates (two in DOTM) without placements. The UBC 'Slacktivism' feature is a marketing alumni news story that states one placement (ASU); it is coded single-record rather than not-a-list because it states a degree-program placement, but it is marketing area. The UC Davis Applied Science dissertation list and the Cambridge chemistry theses page are real author lists in departments outside the project's scope. The Haas news item describes 2010 placements by area and destination without names. No institution-by-host corrections needed.
